title: The neighbours of Netflix's Chumbak Colony are back — Part 2 premieres October 1
summary: The beloved neighbourhood comedy of interconnected families returns for Part 2! 8 fresh episodes of Chumbak will be available to stream on Netflix starting October 1.
body_markdown:
~ Get ready for more chaos, more hungama, and above all, more laughter — 8 new episodes premiere October 1 ~


On September 10, Netflix welcomed audiences into a vibrant colony filled with warmth, mayhem, laughter, and unforgettable characters. From


Hats Off Production


, written and directed by


Aatish Kapadia


and produced alongside


Jamnadas (JD) Majethia


, this beloved neighbourhood comedy of interconnected families returns for Part 2! 8 fresh episodes of


Chumbak


will be available to stream on Netflix starting October 1.


The first part took audiences right into the heart of the colony, where one resident’s problem snowballed into everyone’s problem, and chaos ensued. The end of episode 8 left audiences with plenty of open-ended questions, no shortage of laugh-out-loud moments, and a warm dose of nostalgia for old neighbourhoods! Part 2 brings a fresh set of mix-ups to the colony, putting friendships to a hilarious test as the whole neighbourhood gets tangled up in it. Amid it all, Rajni and Kuku (Neena Gupta and Deven Bhojani) take it upon themselves to bring everyone back together — making for a wholesome, entertaining watch that's the perfect excuse to gather the whole family on the couch.


Speaking about the new episodes, Neena Gupta said


,


"Chumbak has received so much love, and I'm truly grateful for it. Making this show took me right back to my own childhood, to a time when neighbours were practically family, always in and out of each other's homes, always a little too involved in each other's business! That same warmth was there on our set too. Working with Aatish, JD, and this entire cast felt like being part of one big, joyful family, and we truly had the time of our lives making this show. Every family in this colony has their own story to tell, and Part 2 brings so much more of all of that. There is more madness, more heart, and yes, a lot more of Rajni's journey too. I can't wait for all of you to see what's next."


"Thank you for loving Kuku despite all his flaws and innocent mistakes. Many, many thanks from all of us to everyone who embraced this colony,"


added Deven Bhojani.


"Kuku has a special place in my heart, there's a certain innocence to him that's been such a joy to bring to life. Honestly, every character in Chumbak has their own quirks, there's something so endearing about each of them that you can't help but root for them. The second part is nothing short of entertaining, in true JD & Aatish style!"


The stellar star cast—featuring


Neena Gupta, Deven Bhojani, Arjun Bijlani, Helly Shah, Manasi Parekh, Sumeet Vyas, Sandeepa Dhar, Sumeet Raghavan, Anant V. Joshi, Amyra Dastur, Delnaaz Irani


and


Atul Kumar


—is set to return as everyone continues poking into each other’s business. With everyone being over involved in each other’s lives, the next 8 episodes promise more twists, moments of togetherness and, of course, chaos that makes


Chumbak


what it is.


So round up your relatives, invite your friends, and bring over the neighbours! You surely won't want to miss a single second of the madness unfolding in


Chumbak


Colony.


Chumbak


Part 2 premieres on October 1, only on Netflix.
